summary.text: Wes Bennett is the Republican candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election. A financial consultant, he says he served six years as State Commissioner of the Department of Local Government Finance and began public service in 2005 as Plainfield's Clerk-Treasurer.

paragraphs.text: Wes Bennett graduated from Plainfield High School and earned an associate degree from Indiana Wesleyan University in 2000.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he spent more than 25 years in banking, insurance, investments and mortgage lending before entering public service.

He said he began public service in 2005 as Clerk-Treasurer for the Town of Plainfield, then served two years at the Utility Regulatory Commission and six years as State Commissioner of the Department of Local Government Finance.
Bennett said he has lived in Plainfield since 1969 and has been married for 40 years, with two sons and two grandsons.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
He listed safety and security, affordability and fiscal responsibility, and education as his campaign's key messages.
